svg.title: Override control of the jacket temperature
svg.desc: With tracking, the jacket-limiting controller takes over at 23.6 seconds and holds the jacket at 41.8 degrees Celsius while the vessel stops at the feasible 38.16 degrees; when the setpoint falls to 37 degrees the vessel controller is back at once. Without tracking the jacket overshoots to 43.17 degrees and the vessel stays at 38.17 degrees after the setpoint change; the vessel PI alone drives the jacket to 44 degrees.
svg.text: Override control of the jacket temperature
Control Studio recording of this project · setpoint 40 °C, then 37 °C from 40 s · numbers answer the predictions
